description: This file defines a class 'Validators' containing static methods for common input validation tasks such as required field check, email validation, minimum length check, and matching fields validation.

classes.name: Validators
classes.description: Provides static validation methods for form inputs, including required fields, email format, minimum length, and matching values.

methods.name: required
methods.description: Checks if the input value is null or empty after trimming, returns an error string if invalid.

methods.name: email
methods.description: Validates that the input string matches a simple email pattern.

methods.name: minLength
methods.description: Ensures that the input string has at least the specified minimum length.

methods.name: matches
methods.description: Checks if two input strings match, used for password confirmation or similar scenarios.
